about: Development set (round 6, written by the rule author before the benefactive rules): who did the favour for whom. 〜てくれた / 〜てくれる / 〜てくださる / 〜てもらう / 〜ていただく / 〜てあげる / 〜てやる and English 'for me / for you / thanks for ...ing', right and wrong, both directions, third-party givers, a role word for the speaker, questions, requests, past and future, plus near misses (conditional, quoted, 'cho' as 'let' or a final particle, 'cho' inside a noun phrase). Same fields as the held-out sets: 'own' = the speaker's word for themself, 'other' = for the listener; 'wrong' = [word, k], k the 0-based index among case-insensitive whole-word occurrences in the translation; 'ref' = a right translation with every pronoun use of the pair tagged. Dev data: rules may be tuned on it.
